record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: Can one construct an entire function F on C^n, a positive continuous function L, two disjoint unbounded domains G1 and G2 whose union is C^n, and two directions b1 and b2 such that F satisfies the bounded L-index defining inequality in direction b1 throughout G1 and in direction b2 throughout G2, but fails that same bounded-index inequality in direction b2 on G1 and in direction b1 on G2?

artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among open problems on entire functions of bounded L-index in direction formulated by Bandura and Skaskiv (2015). Recent surveys and papers on slice holomorphic functions and L-index in direction continue to cite these problems as open, and no construction or impossibility proof for this domain-dependent directional-index question has been located.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bounded L-index in direction and references open problems formulated in this theory.
status_evidence.claim: The theory contains a list of open problems concerning bounded L-index in direction that subsequent works build upon.

status_evidence.title: Entire function of bounded and unbounded index in direction
status_evidence.snippet: Studies properties of entire functions in C^n of bounded index in a fixed direction.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work defining the directional bounded L-index notion used in the problem.
